title: Two random men and a bunch of Broadway legends 😍😍😍 #Broadway #Theatre...
transcript: Steve Carell and John C. Reilly coming to Broadway in The Odd Couple. Yawn. Boring. Never heard of them. What I wanna talk about is the absolutely stacked ensemble of Broadway performers they got to join them. We've got Laura Benanti, Heléne Yorke, James Monroe Iglehart, Rob Mcclure, Kevin Del Aguila, David Zayas. Absolutely stacked. I'm particularly excited about Lara Bignanti and Helene von York, since they have not been on Broadway in a while. Lara's last Broadway project was my Fair Lady, all the way back in 2018 2019. And this is Heléne Yorke's first show back on Broadway since going on to star in one of the greatest shows of all time, the other two. Which? Side note, if you're not watching the other two, go watch the other two. It's on HBO. It's only three seasons. It's a really short binge, but it is so funny. I'm getting off track. Anyways, I think it's really cool that they gave these two unknown actors, Steve and John, I think that's their names, the chance to star alongside some of Broadway's best. What an amazing opportunity for them. And I hope they're not too intimidated by the fact that most of the audience is probably there to see the Broadway stars and not, you know, whoever they are. But I'm sure they'll do great.
classificationReason: Creator is discussing casting news for a Broadway production of The Odd Couple (not on the list), excited about the ensemble of Broadway veterans joining Steve Carell and John C. Reilly. No personal attendance or review of a live production.
